changelog: Sanitize: remove hardcoded personal paths and names
summary: Memory Bank text-based update workflow following integrated-rules v6.12. Use when updating memory bank files manually via markdown editing — creating edit chunks, updating tasks.md, session_cache.md, session files, and task files. NOT for database-native workflows (use mb-db-workflow instead). Triggers on phrases like "update memory bank", "create edit chunk", "update tasks.md", "update session cache", "memory bank update workflow".
